# `browser-extension/services/BrowserCredentialFieldDispatcher.js`

> **Source:** `webgpu-os/browser-extension/services/BrowserCredentialFieldDispatcher.js`

Trusted isolated-world credential field inspection and fill dispatch. Secret values enter only the exact Chrome document execution call and are never returned. This module performs no submission, click, navigation, screenshot, logging, challenge solving, or passkey ceremony.
